facts.fact: 座堂钟楼顶上悬着一口大钟，钟腹大得能装下她整个身子。
facts.anchor: the round dome of the cathedral bell, big enough to fit her whole body inside

facts.fact: 牧师把杯子斟到齐沿，把酒瓶递给 Archie。
facts.anchor: He had filled the glass to the absolute brim, handing the bottle to Archie.

facts.fact: 这位英国人迟疑一下，随即对着瓶口直接喝。
facts.anchor: The Englishman hesitated for a moment and then swigged directly from the neck.

facts.fact: 她不肯认输，拒绝坐着等死。
facts.anchor: She refused to give up.

facts.fact: 她主动说，如果他愿意，她可以吻他。
facts.anchor: “If you want, I’d kiss you.”

facts.fact: 牧师抗议说这是上帝的殿。
facts.anchor: “This is a house of God!”

facts.fact: 糯米只剩最后六粒。
facts.anchor: Six precious grains were all that remained.

facts.fact: 他递来的是她见过他无意识摆弄的那枚银豆。
facts.anchor: It was the silver bean she had seen him fidgeting with absent-mindedly

facts.fact: Archie 说那是母亲给他的护身符。
facts.anchor: It’s a lucky charm my mother gave me

facts.fact: 她想活，但没想活到肯让岛上别的人去当尸群的饲料。
facts.anchor: She wanted to survive, but not badly enough that she would let the other residents be fodder for the undead.

facts.fact: 圣水要水、十字和神父三样。
facts.anchor: Water, a cross and a priest

facts.fact: 她说要骗尸群去吃豆腐。
facts.anchor: I’m going to trick them into eating tofu.

facts.fact: 她解释原来的故事是骗鬼吃豆腐、别让它吃人。
facts.anchor: the original story was that you want to trick a ghost into eating tofu instead of eating people

facts.fact: 爬上通往大钟的粗绳并不算难。
facts.anchor: It was not that difficult to climb the thick rope up to the bell at the very top.

facts.fact: 她把圣经的残页拍贴在钟腹一侧。
facts.anchor: She slapped the torn pages of the Bible onto one side of the curved bell

facts.fact: 她在符上添了一撇长尾和一个「十」，因为那一笔像十字。
facts.anchor: A long trailing tail and ten because it looked like the crosses

facts.fact: 她只剩两小瓶鸡血。
facts.anchor: She had two vials of chicken blood left.

facts.fact: 她用铜钱剑割断钟绳。
facts.anchor: used it to slice through the tether of the bell rope

facts.fact: 尸群转身离开 Archie 和 Nairns 牧师。
facts.anchor: The geongsi below pivoted away from Archie and Reverend Nairns

facts.fact: 她答应「以后」。
facts.anchor: “Later,” she promised

facts.fact: 那是他第一次把她的名字念对。
facts.anchor: It was the first time he had finally said her name right.

facts.fact: 她估计这一下要花掉自己几年寿命。
facts.anchor: A few years of her life, she supposed.

facts.fact: 剑一劈下去就断了。
facts.anchor: The sword snapped on impact.

facts.fact: 影兽就是 Archie。
facts.anchor: It was Archie.
